evidence.title: Figure and Nscale Sign Strategic Partnership For Up to 100,000 GPUs on the NVIDIA Vera Rubin Platform
evidence.excerpt: Figure and Nscale Sign Strategic Partnership For Up to 100,000 GPUs on the NVIDIA Vera Rubin Platform September 03, 2026 Today we are announcing a partnership with Nscale to deploy the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform for up to 100,000 GPUs targeted for initial deployment starting the second half of 2027 in Barstow, Texas. This deal represents an initial commitment of $3.5 billion of compute with intent to scale to over $6 billion. As part of the agreement, Nscale is also making a strategic investment in Figure, and the parties will also explore the potential to scale Nscale’s supply chain with humanoids. Figure is entering a phase where we are largely bound by data and compute needed to train Helix. Last week, we announced Index , Figure’s effort to build the most diverse humanoid training dataset ever assembled, which is generating 35 minutes of data every second. But data alone cannot solve this problem. Scaling physical intelligence will require an immense amount of compute.
